  .tab-content { display: none; }
  .tab-content.active { display: block; }

<div class="app-container">

  
  <div class="header">
    <div class="header-bg"></div>

    </div>

    <div class="coop-name-wrap">
      <div class="coop-name">สหกรณ์ออมทรัพย์ครูอุดรธานี จำกัด</div>
    </div>
    <div class="coop-sub">Udon Thani Teachers Savings Cooperative</div>
    <div class="header-divider"></div>
  </div>

  
  <div class="tab-bar">
    <button class="tab-btn active" onclick="switchTab('reg')">🔢 เลขทะเบียน</button>
    <button class="tab-btn" onclick="switchTab('name')">🔤 ค้นหาชื่อ</button>
    <button class="tab-btn" onclick="switchTab('qr')">📱 QR Code</button>
  </div>

  
  <div id="tab-reg" class="tab-content active">
    <div class="search-section">
      <div class="section-label">🔍 ค้นหาด้วยเลขทะเบียนสมาชิก</div>

      
      <div class="display-box">
        <div id="display" class="display-placeholder">กรอกเลขทะเบียน</div>
        <button class="clear-btn" onclick="clearAll()">✕</button>
      </div>

      
      <div class="keypad">
        <button class="key" onclick="pressKey('1')">1</button>
        <button class="key" onclick="pressKey('2')">2</button>
        <button class="key" onclick="pressKey('3')">3</button>
        <button class="key" onclick="pressKey('4')">4</button>
        <button class="key" onclick="pressKey('5')">5</button>
        <button class="key" onclick="pressKey('6')">6</button>
        <button class="key" onclick="pressKey('7')">7</button>
        <button class="key" onclick="pressKey('8')">8</button>
        <button class="key" onclick="pressKey('9')">9</button>
        <button class="key key-0" onclick="pressKey('0')">0</button>
        <button class="key key-del" onclick="deleteLast()">⌫</button>
        <button class="key-search" onclick="searchByReg()">
          🔍 ค้นหา
          <span>Search Member</span>
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="result-section" id="reg-result"></div>
  </div>

  
  <div id="tab-name" class="tab-content">
    <div class="search-section">
      <div class="section-label">🔤 ค้นหาด้วยชื่อ-สกุล</div>
      <div class="name-search-wrap" style="border-top:none; margin-top:0; padding-top:0;">
        <div class="name-input-row">
          <input type="text" class="name-input" id="nameInput" placeholder="พิมพ์ชื่อ หรือ นามสกุล..." oninput="searchByName()">
          <button class="name-search-btn" onclick="searchByName()">ค้นหา</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="result-section" id="name-result"></div>
  </div>

  
  <div id="tab-qr" class="tab-content">
    <div class="qr-section">
      <div class="qr-card">
        <div class="qr-title">📱 QR CODE ค้นหาสมาชิก — ออฟไลน์ได้</div>

        
        <div id="qrcode" style="display:flex;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:14px;min-height:240px;align-items:center;">
          <div style="color:rgba(255,255,255,0.3);font-size:13px;text-align:center;padding:20px;line-height:2.5;">
            ⏳ กำลังโหลด...
          </div>
        </div>

        <div id="qrStatus" style="font-size:13px;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.5);margin-bottom:14px;text-align:center;"></div>

        
        <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;margin-bottom:16px;">
          <button onclick="printQR()"
            style="flex:1;padding:12px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#c9a227,#e8c547);border:none;border-radius:12px;color:#0a1628;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;font-family:'Sarabun',sans-serif;cursor:pointer;">
            🖨️ พิมพ์ QR
          </button>
          <button onclick="downloadQR()"
            style="flex:1;padding:12px;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.07);border:1px solid rgba(201,162,39,0.3);border-radius:12px;color:var(--gold2);font-size:13px;font-weight:700;font-family:'Sarabun',sans-serif;cursor:pointer;">
            💾 บันทึกภาพ
          </button>
        </div>

        
        <div style="border-top:1px solid rgba(201,162,39,0.15);padding-top:14px;">
          <div style="font-size:10px;color:rgba(201,162,39,0.6);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:1.5px;margin-bottom:7px;text-align:left;">
            🌐 URL ของไฟล์นี้ (วางเมื่ออัปโหลดแล้ว)
          </div>
          <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;">
            <input type="text" id="qrUrlInput"
              placeholder="https://your-url.com/member_search.html"
              style="flex:1;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.05);border:1.5px solid rgba(201,162,39,0.25);border-radius:10px;padding:10px 13px;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.7);font-size:11px;font-family:'Sarabun',sans-serif;outline:none;"
              oninput="refreshQR()"
            >
            <button onclick="pasteURL()"
              style="padding:10px 14px;background:rgba(201,162,39,0.15);border:1px solid rgba(201,162,39,0.3);border-radius:10px;color:var(--gold2);font-size:13px;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;">
              📋
            </button>
          </div>
          <div style="font-size:10px;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.25);margin-top:6px;">

          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="qr-url" id="qrUrlDisplay" style="word-break:break-all;font-size:10px;color:rgba(201,162,39,0.35);margin-top:8px;"></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

const MEMBERS = _CD.d.map(r => ({reg:r[0],name:r[1],school:_CD.s[r[2]],session:r[3],seq:r[4],date:r[5]}));

let currentInput = '';

function switchTab(tab) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach((b,i) => b.classList.remove('active'));
  document.querySelectorAll('.tab-content').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('active'));
  const tabs = ['reg','name','qr'];
  const idx = tabs.indexOf(tab);
  document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn')[idx].classList.add('active');
  document.getElementById('tab-'+tab).classList.add('active');
  if(tab==='qr') generateQR();
}

function pressKey(k) {
  if(currentInput.length >= 8) return;
  currentInput += k;
  updateDisplay();
  rippleEffect(event);
}

function deleteLast() {
  currentInput = currentInput.slice(0,-1);
  updateDisplay();
}

function clearAll() {
  currentInput = '';
  updateDisplay();
  document.getElementById('reg-result').innerHTML = '';
}

function updateDisplay() {
  const el = document.getElementById('display');
  if(currentInput) {
    el.className = 'display-value';
    el.textContent = currentInput;
  } else {
    el.className = 'display-placeholder';
    el.textContent = 'กรอกเลขทะเบียน';
  }
}

function searchByReg() {
  const q = currentInput.trim();
  if(!q) return;
  const results = MEMBERS.filter(m => m.reg === q || m.reg === q.padStart(6,'0'));
  renderRegResult(results, q);
}

function searchByName() {
  const q = document.getElementById('nameInput').value.trim();
  if(q.length < 2) {
    document.getElementById('name-result').innerHTML = '';
    return;
  }
  const results = MEMBERS.filter(m => m.name.includes(q)).slice(0, 30);
  renderNameResult(results, q);
}

function renderRegResult(results, q) {
  const el = document.getElementById('reg-result');
  if(results.length === 0) {
    el.innerHTML = `
      <div class="result-card result-not-found">
        <div style="font-size:40px;margin-bottom:12px;">❌</div>
        <div style="font-size:18px;font-weight:700;color:#ff6b6b;margin-bottom:6px;">ไม่พบข้อมูลสมาชิก</div>
        <div style="font-size:14px;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.5);">เลขทะเบียน: ${q}</div>
        <div style="font-size:13px;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.4);margin-top:8px;">กรุณาตรวจสอบเลขทะเบียนอีกครั้ง</div>
      </div>`;
    return;
  }
  el.innerHTML = results.map(m => resultCardHTML(m)).join('');
}

function renderNameResult(results, q) {
  const el = document.getElementById('name-result');
  if(results.length === 0) {
    el.innerHTML = `
      <div class="result-card result-not-found">
        <div style="font-size:32px;margin-bottom:10px;">🔍</div>
        <div style="font-size:16px;font-weight:700;color:#ff6b6b;margin-bottom:4px;">ไม่พบสมาชิก</div>
        <div style="font-size:13px;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.4);">ลองพิมพ์ชื่อหรือนามสกุลใหม่อีกครั้ง</div>
      </div>`;
    return;
  }
  const count = results.length >= 30 ? 'แสดง 30 รายการแรก' : `พบ ${results.length} รายการ`;
  el.innerHTML = `<div class="result-count">✅ ${count}</div>
    <div class="multi-results">${results.map(m => multiCardHTML(m)).join('')}</div>`;
}

function resultCardHTML(m) {
  const seqNo = m.seq || '';
  return `
    <div class="result-card result-found">
      <div class="result-header">
        <div class="result-header-inner">
          <div class="result-icon">✅</div>
          <div>
            <div class="result-status">พบข้อมูลสมาชิก</div>
            <div style="font-size:12px;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.5);">เลขทะเบียน: ${m.reg}</div>
            <div style="font-size:11px;color:rgba(201,162,39,0.8);margin-top:2px;">📋 ครั้งที่ ${m.session} — ${m.date}</div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="seq-badge">
          <div class="seq-badge-label">ลำดับที่</div>
          <div class="seq-badge-number">${seqNo}</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="result-body">
        <div class="member-name">${m.name}</div>
        <div class="member-info">
          <div class="info-row">
            <span class="info-label">เลขทะเบียน</span>
            <span class="info-value">${m.reg}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="info-row">
            <span class="info-label">สังกัด</span>
            <span class="info-value">${m.school || '-'}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="info-row">
            <span class="info-label">ครั้งที่ประชุม</span>
            <span class="info-value">ครั้งที่ ${m.session}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="info-row">
            <span class="info-label">วันที่ประชุม</span>
            <span class="info-value">${m.date}</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="session-badge">📅 ประชุมสัมมนาปี 2569</div>
      </div>
    </div>`;
}

function multiCardHTML(m) {
  return `
    <div class="multi-card">
      <div class="member-name">${m.name}</div>
      <div class="member-info">
        <div class="info-row">
          <span class="info-label">เลขทะเบียน</span>
          <span class="info-value">${m.reg}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="info-row">
          <span class="info-label">สังกัด</span>
          <span class="info-value">${m.school || '-'}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="info-row">
          <span class="info-label">วันที่ประชุม</span>
          <span class="info-value">ครั้งที่ ${m.session} — ${m.date}</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>`;
}

function rippleEffect(e) {
  if(!e || !e.currentTarget) return;
  const btn = e.currentTarget;
  const ripple = document.createElement('span');
  ripple.className = 'ripple';
  const rect = btn.getBoundingClientRect();
  const size = Math.max(rect.width, rect.height);
  ripple.style.cssText = `width:${size}px;height:${size}px;left:${(rect.width-size)/2}px;top:${(rect.height-size)/2}px`;
  btn.appendChild(ripple);
  setTimeout(() => ripple.remove(), 600);
}

function generateQR() {
  const input = document.getElementById('qrUrlInput');
  if(!input) return;
  const cur = window.location.href;
  if(!input.value && cur && !cur.startsWith('about:') && !cur.startsWith('blob:') && !cur.startsWith('file:')) {
    input.value = cur;
  }
  refreshQR();
}

async function pasteURL() {
  try {
    const text = await navigator.clipboard.readText();
    document.getElementById('qrUrlInput').value = text.trim();
    refreshQR();
  } catch(e) {
    const input = document.getElementById('qrUrlInput');
    input.focus(); input.select();
  }
}

let qrGenTimeout = null;
function refreshQR() {
  clearTimeout(qrGenTimeout);
  qrGenTimeout = setTimeout(async () => {
    let url = document.getElementById('qrUrlInput').value.trim();
    const el = document.getElementById('qrcode');
    const statusEl = document.getElementById('qrStatus');
    const displayEl = document.getElementById('qrUrlDisplay');

    if(!url) {
      const cur = window.location.href;
      if(cur && !cur.startsWith('about:') && !cur.startsWith('blob:') && !cur.startsWith('file:')) {
        url = cur;
        document.getElementById('qrUrlInput').value = url;
      }
    }

    if(!url) {
      el.innerHTML = '<div style="color:rgba(255,255,255,0.25);font-size:13px;text-align:center;padding:30px;line-height:2.5;">🔗 วาง URL ด้านล่าง<br>เพื่อสร้าง QR Code</div>';
      if(statusEl) statusEl.innerHTML = '';
      if(displayEl) displayEl.textContent = '';
      return;
    }

    el.innerHTML = '<div style="color:rgba(255,255,255,0.4);font-size:13px;padding:20px;">⏳ กำลังสร้าง QR...</div>';

    try {
      const lib = window._QRLib;
      const dataUrl = await lib.toDataURL(url, {
        width: 230, margin: 2,
        color: { dark: '#0a1628', light: '#ffffff' },
        errorCorrectionLevel: 'H'
      });

      el.innerHTML = '';
      const img = document.createElement('img');
      img.src = dataUrl;
      img.style.cssText = 'border-radius:14px;border:4px solid rgba(201,162,39,0.45);box-shadow:0 0 28px rgba(201,162,39,0.3),0 0 60px rgba(201,162,39,0.1);width:230px;height:230px;display:block;';
      el.appendChild(img);

      if(statusEl) statusEl.innerHTML =
        '<div style="color:#4caf50;font-weight:700;font-size:13px;margin-bottom:4px;">✅ QR พร้อมใช้งาน — ใช้งานได้ทันที</div>'
        +'<div style="color:rgba(255,255,255,0.4);font-size:12px;">สมาชิกสแกนได้เลย • ทำงาน offline ได้</div>';

      if(displayEl) displayEl.textContent = url.length > 70 ? url.substring(0,70)+'...' : url;

    } catch(err) {
      el.innerHTML = '<div style="color:#ff8a65;font-size:12px;padding:16px;line-height:2;">⚠️ '+err.message+'</div>';
    }
  }, 300);
}

function printQR() {
  const img = document.querySelector('#qrcode img');
  if(!img) { alert('กรุณารอ QR โหลดก่อนครับ'); return; }
  const w = window.open('', '_blank');
  w.document.write(`<!DOCTYPE html><html><head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <style>
      body { margin:0; display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:100vh; background:#fff; font-family:sans-serif; }
      img { width:300px; height:300px; }
      .title { font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin-top:16px; color:#0a1628; }
      .sub { font-size:12px; color:#666; margin-top:6px; }
    </style>
  </head><body>
    <img src="${img.src}">
    <div class="title">สหกรณ์ออมทรัพย์ครูอุดรธานี จำกัด</div>
    <div class="sub">สแกน QR เพื่อค้นหาชื่อในระบบลงทะเบียน</div>
    <div class="sub">ประชุมสัมมนาประจำปี 2569</div>
    <script>window.onload=()=>window.print();<\/script>
  </body></html>`);
  w.document.close();
}

function downloadQR() {
  const img = document.querySelector('#qrcode img');
  if(!img) { alert('กรุณารอ QR โหลดก่อนครับ'); return; }
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = img.src;
  a.download = 'QR_UDSCC_สมาชิก2569.png';
  a.click();
}

// Enter key support
document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  if(e.key >= '0' && e.key <= '9') pressKey(e.key);
  if(e.key === 'Backspace') deleteLast();
  if(e.key === 'Enter') searchByReg();
});

// Auto generate QR on page load
window.addEventListener('load', () => {
  setTimeout(() => generateQR(), 300);
});
</script>
</body>
</html>
